breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained conflicting instructions for the numerical method, specifying both 'Explicit forward Euler' and a detailed 'Strang splitting' procedure. The ground truth correctly removes the 'Explicit forward Euler' instruction to resolve the conflict. The agent failed to resolve this, as the generated specification includes both contradictory instructions: 'Employ an explicit forward Euler time integration scheme' and 'Implement Strang splitting for each full time step dt'.
